description: This file defines the EmployeeReportingMethodService class in the OrangeHRM project, specifically within the PIM (Personal Information Management) plugin. It provides methods for retrieving employee supervising relationships and managing related data using a Data Access Object (DAO).

classes.name: EmployeeReportingMethodService
classes.description: Service class providing functionalities related to employee reporting relationships, such as fetching supervisors and subordinates, using DAO and data transfer object classes.

methods.name: getEmployeeReportingMethodDao
methods.description: Lazy-initializes and returns the EmployeeReportingMethodDao instance used to access reporting data.

methods.name: setEmployeeReportingMethodDao
methods.description: Sets the EmployeeReportingMethodDao instance, allowing dependency injection or mocking.

methods.name: getImmediateSupervisorListForEmployee
methods.description: Retrieves a list of immediate supervisors for an employee based on provided filter parameters.

methods.name: getImmediateSupervisorListCountForEmployee
methods.description: Returns the count of immediate supervisors matching the given filter criteria for an employee.

methods.name: getSubordinateListForEmployee
methods.description: Retrieves a list of subordinates for an employee based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getSubordinateListCountForEmployee
methods.description: Counts the number of subordinates for an employee based on specific filter parameters.

methods.name: getAccessibleAndAvailableSupervisorsIdCombinedList
methods.description: Combines two lists of employee IDs: accessible supervisors and already assigned supervisors, returning the list of accessible, not yet assigned supervisors.

methods.name: getAlreadyAssignedSupervisorsSubordinatesAndSelfIdCombinedList
methods.description: Merges lists of supervisors, subordinates, and includes the employee's own ID to form a combined list of related employee IDs.
